ctaHeading: Thomastown's heating and cooling specialists — let's get your system sorted.
aboutText: Frazer Air has been keeping Thomastown homes and businesses comfortable with professional heating and cooling solutions. Based on Goodyear Drive in Thomastown, we specialise in split system installation, ducted heating and cooling, and gas heating across Melbourne's northern suburbs. Our licensed technicians are committed to delivering quality workmanship and honest, transparent service on every job.
servicesText: From new installations to emergency repairs, Frazer Air provides a full range of heating and cooling services for residential and commercial properties across Thomastown and surrounding suburbs.

services.title: Split System Installation
services.desc: Expert installation of energy-efficient split system air conditioners to keep your Thomastown home cool in summer and warm in winter.

services.title: Ducted Heating & Cooling
services.desc: Whole-home climate control with professionally installed ducted heating and cooling systems tailored to your property.

services.title: Gas Heating
services.desc: Reliable and efficient gas heating solutions to keep your family warm through Melbourne's cold winter months.

services.title: Air Conditioning Repair & Service
services.desc: Fast, affordable repair and regular servicing to keep your air conditioning system running at peak performance.

services.title: Commercial HVAC
services.desc: Tailored heating and cooling solutions for Thomastown businesses, from offices to retail spaces and warehouses.

services.title: Emergency HVAC Repairs
services.desc: Urgent heating and cooling repairs available when you need them most, minimising downtime and discomfort.
